items.title: Frank Goudie Interview
items.q: Yeah, well, your style to me is more like Polo Barnes and George Lewis, the, on clarinet, I mean.

ctx.x: I think he can see him settling down in Eli Cabaret as if it was yesterday. He was playing. Boy, he's a young, young man. Swing like mad. I could still, right now, I could see him as if it was yesterday. Just as delicate as he could have played. Well, those guys, he's creative. That's one thing. I never tried to break my head to go and try to do what they were doing. And still, if they were doing, they still are doing. They are creators. They made it possible for all planet players. And it would be sort of…
Yeah, well, your style to me is more like Polo Barnes and George Lewis, the, on clarinet, I mean.
Well, I, as I said, I would like, I loved their style, but I couldn't play what they played.
